title: Integer endpoint discontinuity of normalized uniformization for positively curved surfaces
description: For every finite integer r >= 0, smooth complete metrics of strictly positive Gaussian curvature on the plane and sphere converge in ordinary compact-open C^r while their unique point-normalized uniformizing diffeomorphisms fail C^(r+1) convergence. The critical r=1 case uses an exact nonlinear curvature correction. Extensively AI-assisted, unrefereed research; no human peer review or external acceptance is claimed. Classical endpoint mechanisms are credited. A bounded primary-source search through 3 October 2026 found no verified earlier full geometric resolution, with residual earlier unindexed realization risk.
